# Quizkit prompts

Ready-made instructions that make ChatGPT, Claude or any other AI write quizzes in the format Quizkit imports. Use them in the app (Prompts tab) or straight from here, for example to prepare JSON files on a computer.

1. Open a prompt below and copy the text in the box.
2. Paste it into the AI together with your material (notes, a PDF, past exam questions…).
3. Paste the reply into Quizkit (**Import**), or save it as a `.json` file and pick it there.

The format itself is described in [format.md](../format.md). Example files are in [examples/](../../examples/).

## English

| Prompt | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [Quiz from notes / PDF](en/notes.md) | Turns lecture notes, a book chapter, slides or a PDF into a quiz. |
| [Quiz from past exam questions](en/past-exam.md) | Copies exam questions word for word, in order. |
| [Whole course: folders in one go](en/course.md) | One quiz per unit or year, organized into folders. |
| [Math / formula quiz](en/math.md) | Numeric and formula questions with LaTeX rules. |
| [Quiz from terms and definitions](en/terms.md) | A glossary, a list of concepts or vocabulary words. |
| [Quiz from a topic name](en/topic.md) | No source material: from the AI’s own knowledge. |
| [Fix a broken JSON](en/fix-json.md) | Paste it together with the app’s error message. |
